summary: LLM observability has become one of the most consequential infrastructure decisions for AI teams, with roughly 73% of enterprises now requiring AI agent monitoring in production. These tools provide visibility into traces, latency, token usage, quality metrics, and costs, closing the widening gap between teams running production-grade monitoring and those flying blind. The right platform helps debug multi-step agents, control spend, and maintain output quality at scale.

tools.name: LangSmith
tools.monitors: End-to-end traces, multi-step agent workflows, unified workflow costs, latency, token usage, and evaluation/quality metrics.
features: Deep tracing for complex multi-step agent diagnostics
Unified workflow cost tracking across chains and agents
SmithDB backend with ~12x faster trace queries
tools.pricing: Free Developer tier (~5K traces/mo); Plus plan at $39/seat/mo; custom Enterprise pricing.
tools.best_for: Teams building complex LLM agents (especially in the LangChain ecosystem) that need detailed multi-step debugging and evaluation.

tools.name: Helicone
tools.monitors: API requests at the proxy/gateway level, token usage, costs, latency, caching, and request metadata.
features: Proxy-gateway deployment for fast setup (one-line integration)
Request caching to reduce redundant calls
Rate limiting and custom header/metadata logging
Daily regression testing alongside production traffic
tools.pricing: Free tier with 10,000 requests/mo; usage-based paid plans beyond that.
tools.best_for: Chatbots and teams wanting fast setup plus a gateway layer for cost control and spend reduction.

tools.name: Weights & Biases (W&B)
tools.monitors: ML experiments, model training runs, LLM traces (via Weave), evaluations, prompts, and production performance.
features: W&B Weave for LLM tracing and evaluation
Integrates ML and LLM workflows in one platform
tools.pricing: Free personal tier; Team and Enterprise plans with usage-based and custom pricing.
tools.best_for: ML-heavy teams that already run experiments in W&B and want to unify traditional ML and LLM observability.

tools.name: Arize AI
tools.monitors: Production model and LLM performance, drift, embeddings, retrieval quality (via Phoenix), latency, and traces.
features: Arize Phoenix open-source tracing and evaluation
tools.pricing: Phoenix is free/open-source; Arize AX offers free tier plus custom Enterprise pricing.
tools.best_for: RAG applications and production ML/LLM teams needing deep retrieval quality and drift monitoring.

tools.name: LangFuse
tools.monitors: Traces, spans, per-LLM-call costs, token usage, latency, prompt versions, and evaluation scores.
tools.pricing: Free self-hosted (open source); managed cloud with free Hobby tier and usage-based paid plans.
tools.best_for: Agent and production teams wanting open-source, self-hostable observability with granular cost tracking.

tools.name: OpenLLMetry
tools.monitors: LLM calls, traces, token usage, latency, and costs via OpenTelemetry-standard instrumentation.
features: Vendor-neutral instrumentation (export to any OTel backend)
Automatic instrumentation for popular LLM SDKs and vector DBs
Integrates with existing observability stacks (Datadog, Grafana, etc.)
tools.pricing: Free and open-source (SDK); costs depend on the chosen backend/destination. Traceloop offers a managed hosted option with free and paid tiers.
tools.best_for: Engineering teams wanting standards-based, vendor-neutral instrumentation that plugs into their existing OpenTelemetry backends.

cost_tips: Use a gateway/proxy layer (like Helicone or Portkey) with caching to eliminate redundant or duplicate API calls and automatically reduce spend.
Route requests to the smallest capable model and reserve expensive frontier models only for complex tasks; tiered model routing can cut costs dramatically.
Optimize and trim prompts, limit max output tokens, and shorten context windows since you pay per input and output token.
Set budgets, rate limits, and cost alerts in your observability tool to catch runaway usage and track per-feature or per-user spend before it escalates.
